name: Shinonome
source:
Likes: White Rice, Sweets
Hobby: Laying around the house watching sports and eating snacks.

A kanzashi item spirit that suddenly appears in front of the protagonist.
A lazy guy that goes at his own pace and loves eating. When bothersome tasks come up he makes the excuse that he's too old and runs off.
He's kind to women above others and tends to act over-familiar.
